_about: Formation stats. Formations use the same ranks as gear (Worn, Forged, Tempered, Masterwork, Ascended: see gear.json for multipliers, max levels and upgrade costs).

Each formation's 'stats' are bonuses for a Worn formation at level 1. They grow with the rank multiplier (same as gear) and by levelBonus per level, which is gentler than gear's so percentage bonuses don't max out halfway (a maxed Ascended formation is about 5x a Worn level 1). 'drawbacks' never grow, so a higher rank is always better.
Team = your hero and minions. Hero = your main character only. Enemy = the other side (negative values weaken them).
Numbers came from the original formation cards: Resilience -> Health/Armour, Aggression -> Damage, Cooperation -> Inner Peace, Opposition -> Enemy.
